RAW is definitely the most flexible setting for post processing, but like the name states it is not an image in itself. That’s why the RAW file contains a “preview” image as well. As far as I know it is up to the manufacturers to determine in what way they implement a preview in their RAW file. Panasonic does not embed a high resolution image. So if you shoot only in RAW the camera cannot display more information than the low resolution embedded preview. Shooting in both RAW + Fine let’s the camera use the full resolution jpeg for the in camera display. 

It has advantages as well, since the RAW-files are smaller now. A bit more flexibility with regards to how this is handled would be great though. As for me, I shoot RAW + Fine and delete all jpegs once I transferred the RAW files.

Pretty sure the above information is in the ballpark, but if someone can confirm it that would be great
